mechanism: Berberine may inhibit CYP2D6 and have mild diuretic properties, potentially enhancing torsemide's effects and increasing electrolyte depletion risk; berberine also has hypotensive properties that could amplify torsemide's blood pressure-lowering effect.
action: Monitor blood pressure, renal function, and electrolytes (particularly potassium) regularly; counsel patient on signs of dehydration and hypokalemia; consider more frequent monitoring if berberine dose is increased.
